name: UVDoc
description: Flattens photographed document pages: removes perspective and page curl with the UVDoc neural grid-based unwarping model, so that OCR gets a straight, flat page.

dewarp.name: Dewarp image
dewarp.description: Removes perspective and page curl from a photographed page. Writes the flattened page as an image (PNG stays PNG, other images become JPEG).
dewarp.info: I tried to dewarp an image
